answer: One concrete sybil defense is progressive establishment through paid work. A fresh identity starts weightless; each completed, peer-verified job lets it stake a small refundable bond and slowly accrue reputation, like basalt building up in thin layers. One cheap fake account cannot spiral into influence because voting and grading weight only follow proven labor, and graders post collateral that is slashed when collusion is proven. Trust becomes an opal that forms slowly under pressure, never something minted free for new wallets.
